import baskets = "./baskets.qui"

class Itemset(string[] items, int count)

string[][] one_smaller_subsets(string[] items)
    string[][] result := []
    for: index < #items
        result = result.append(items[0:<index].concat(items[index + 1:<#items]))
    return result

class Candidates()
    joined := 0
    excluded := 0
    pruned := 0
    string[][] itemsets := []

Candidates generate_candidates(string[][] previous, int size, map<string, string> taxonomy, bool exclude_categories)
    result := Candidates()
    map<string, bool> known
    for items := previous[]
        .known.set(items.join("+"), true)
    for: left < #previous
        first := previous[left]
        for: left + 1 <= right < #previous
            second := previous[right]
            if first[0:<#first - 1] != second[0:<#second - 1]
                break
            result.joined += 1
            candidate := first.append(second[-1])
            excluded := false
            if exclude_categories and size == 2
                match taxonomy.get(candidate[0])
                    string category
                        excluded = category == candidate[1]
                    none
                        void
                match taxonomy.get(candidate[1])
                    string category
                        excluded = excluded or category == candidate[0]
                    none
                        void
            if excluded
                result.excluded += 1
                continue
            pruned := false
            for subset := one_smaller_subsets(candidate)[]
                if not known.has(subset.join("+"))
                    pruned = true
                    break
            if pruned
                result.pruned += 1
            else
                result.itemsets = result.itemsets.append(candidate)
    return result

class Counter(local string[][] itemsets)
    total := int(#itemsets)
    rows := map<string, int[]>()
    for: index < #itemsets
        for item := itemsets[index][]
            previous := baskets.number_values(rows, item)
            .rows.set(item, previous.append(int(index)))

    int support(string[] wanted)
        if #wanted == 0
            return total
        matching := baskets.number_values(rows, wanted[0])
        for: 1 <= index < int(#wanted)
            next_rows := baskets.number_values(rows, wanted[index])
            int[] intersection := []
            left := 0
            right := 0
            while left < int(#matching) and right < int(#next_rows)
                if matching[left] == next_rows[right]
                    intersection = intersection.append(matching[left])
                    left += 1
                    right += 1
                elif matching[left] < next_rows[right]
                    left += 1
                else
                    right += 1
            matching = intersection
            if #matching == 0
                break
        return int(#matching)

map<string, int> count_supports(Counter counter, string[][] candidates)
    map<string, int> result
    for items := candidates[]
        .result.set(items.join("+"), counter.support(items))
    return result

int count_value(map<string, int> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

int[] number_values(map<string, int[]> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        int[] found
            return found
        none
            return []

bool has_item(string[] items, string name)
    for item := items[]
        if item == name
            return true
    return false

bool contains(string[] items, string[] wanted)
    for item := wanted[]
        if not has_item(items, item)
            return false
    return true

string[] unique_sorted(string[] items)
    string[] result := []
    for item := items.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != item
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

class Product(string name, string category, int price)

Product | error product_value(map<string, Product> products, string name)
    match products.get(name)
        Product found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing product {name}")

class Transaction(string tid, string customer, int day)
    counts := map<string, int>()

    string[] products()
        return counts.keys().sorted()

    int units()
        result := 0
        for item := counts.keys()[]
            result += count_value(counts, item)
        return result

bool add_product(Transaction &transaction, string item)
    previous := count_value(transaction.counts, item)
    .transaction.counts.set(item, previous + 1)
    return previous > 0

string[][] read_records(string name)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + name))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    string[][] result := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#lines)
        if lines[index] != ""
            result = result.append(lines[index].split(","))
    return result

string[] extended_basket(string[] items, map<string, string> taxonomy)
    result := items
    for item := items[]
        match taxonomy.get(item)
            string category
                result = result.append(category)
            none
                void
    return unique_sorted(result)

import baskets = "./baskets.qui"
import apriori = "./apriori.qui"

class Pattern(string[] items, int weight)

class Node(string item, int parent)
    count := 0
    children := map<string, int>()

class Tree()
    string[] header := []
    nodes := [Node("", -1)]
    links := map<string, int[]>()

    int support(string item)
        result := 0
        for index := baskets.number_values(links, item)[]
            result += nodes[index].count
        return result

    Pattern[] conditional_base(string item)
        Pattern[] result := []
        for index := baskets.number_values(links, item)[]
            string[] path := []
            ancestor := nodes[index].parent
            while ancestor > 0
                path = [nodes[ancestor].item].concat(path)
                ancestor = nodes[ancestor].parent
            result = result.append(Pattern(path, nodes[index].count))
        return result

Tree build_tree(Pattern[] patterns, int minimum)
    map<string, int> supports
    for pattern := patterns[]
        for item := pattern.items[]
            .supports.set(item, baskets.count_value(supports, item) + pattern.weight)
    result := Tree()
    for item := supports.keys().sorted()[]
        if baskets.count_value(supports, item) >= minimum
            result.header = result.header.append(item)
    for: 1 <= index < int(#result.header)
        item := result.header[index]
        count := baskets.count_value(supports, item)
        position := index
        while position > 0 and baskets.count_value(supports, result.header[position - 1]) < count
            result.header[position] = result.header[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        result.header[position] = item
    for pattern := patterns[]
        current := 0
        for item := result.header[]
            if not baskets.has_item(pattern.items, item)
                continue
            child := -1
            match result.nodes[current].children.get(item)
                int found
                    child = found
                none
                    child = int(#result.nodes)
                    result.nodes = result.nodes.append(Node(item, current))
                    .result.nodes[current].children.set(item, child)
                    linked := baskets.number_values(result.links, item)
                    .result.links.set(item, linked.append(child))
            result.nodes[child].count += pattern.weight
            current = child
    return result

class GrowthResult(int header_count, int node_count)
    conditional_trees := 0
    conditional_nodes := 0
    apriori.Itemset[] itemsets := []

class Frame(Tree tree, string[] suffix)

GrowthResult fp_growth(Pattern[] patterns, int minimum, int max_size)
    whole := build_tree(patterns, minimum)
    result := GrowthResult(int(#whole.header), int(#whole.nodes) - 1)
    stack := [Frame(whole, [])]
    while #stack != 0
        last := #stack - 1
        frame := stack[last]
        stack = stack[0:<last]
        index := int(#frame.tree.header) - 1
        while index >= 0
            item := frame.tree.header[index]
            itemset := frame.suffix.append(item).sorted()
            result.itemsets = result.itemsets.append(apriori.Itemset(itemset, frame.tree.support(item)))
            if int(#itemset) < max_size
                conditional := build_tree(frame.tree.conditional_base(item), minimum)
                if #conditional.nodes > 1
                    stack = stack.append(Frame(conditional, itemset))
                    result.conditional_trees += 1
                    result.conditional_nodes += int(#conditional.nodes) - 1
            index -= 1
    return result

rules.Ratio parse_fraction(string text)
    parts := text.split("/")
    return rules.Ratio(int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]))

class Params(local string[] fields)

    rules.Ratio min_confidence := parse_fraction(fields[1])
    rules.Ratio min_lift := parse_fraction(fields[2])

    test_min_support := int(fields[8])
    recommend_top := int(fields[9])
    matrix_size := int(fields[10])
    rules.Ratio group_min_lift := parse_fraction(fields[11])
    rules.Ratio negative_max_lift := parse_fraction(fields[12])
    negative_min_expected := int(fields[13])
    rules.Ratio trend_threshold := parse_fraction(fields[14])

Params read_params()
    string[] fields := []
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/params.txt"))
    for line := text.split(NL)[]
        if line != ""
            parts := line.split(" ")
            fields = fields.append(parts[1])
    return Params(fields)

int sum_values(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

int[] unique_numbers(int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != value
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

rules.Ratio median(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    middle := #ordered / 2
    if #ordered % 2 == 1
        return rules.Ratio(ordered[middle])
    return rules.Ratio(ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle], 2)

string[] ranked_names(string[] names, map<string, int> counts)
    result := names.sorted()
    for: 1 <= index < int(#result)
        item := result[index]
        count := baskets.count_value(counts, item)
        position := index
        while position > 0 and baskets.count_value(counts, result[position - 1]) < count
            result[position] = result[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        result[position] = item
    return result

class Dataset()
    string[] errors := []
    products := map<string, baskets.Product>()
    item_rows := 0
    transaction_lines := 0
    adopted := 0
    rejected := 0
    duplicates := 0
    baskets.Transaction[] transactions := []

    void .load()
        item_records := baskets.read_records("items.csv")
        item_rows = int(#item_records)
        for: index < #item_records
            row := item_records[index]
            price := int(row[2])
            problem := ""
            if products.has(row[0])
                problem = "duplicate item {row[0]}"
            elif price == 0
                problem = "bad price {price}"
            if problem != ""
                errors = errors.append("items.csv line {index + 2}: {problem}")
            else
                .products.set(row[0], baskets.Product(row[0], row[1], price))
        transaction_records := baskets.read_records("transactions.csv")
        transaction_lines = int(#transaction_records)
        map<string, int> known
        for: index < #transaction_records
            row := transaction_records[index]
            tid := row[0]
            customer := row[1]
            day := int(row[2])
            item := row[3]
            problem := ""
            last := int(#transactions) - 1
            if known.has(tid) and tid != transactions[last].tid
                problem = "tid {tid} not contiguous"
            else
                if not known.has(tid)
                    .known.set(tid, 1)
                    transactions = transactions.append(baskets.Transaction(tid, customer, day))
                    last += 1
                current := transactions[last]
                if customer != current.customer
                    problem = "tid {tid} customer {customer} differs from {current.customer}"
                elif day != current.day
                    problem = "tid {tid} day {day} differs from {current.day}"
                elif not products.has(item)
                    problem = "unknown item {item}"
            if problem != ""
                errors = errors.append("transactions.csv line {index + 2}: {problem}")
                rejected += 1
            else
                adopted += 1
                if baskets.add_product(&transactions[last], item)
                    duplicates += 1

class Level(int number, int candidates, int excluded, int pruned, int counted, string[][] itemsets)

class AprioriResult()
    Level[] levels := []
    apriori.Itemset[] entries := []
    supports := map<string, int>()
    single_counts := map<string, int>()

string[][] add_level(AprioriResult &result, apriori.Counter counter, int number, apriori.Candidates generation, int minimum)
    counted := apriori.count_supports(counter, generation.itemsets)
    string[][] frequent := []
    for items := generation.itemsets[]
        count := baskets.count_value(counted, items.join("+"))
        if number == 1
            .result.single_counts.set(items[0], count)
        if count >= minimum
            frequent = frequent.append(items)
            result.entries = result.entries.append(apriori.Itemset(items, count))
            .result.supports.set(items.join("+"), count)
    result.levels = result.levels.append(Level(number, generation.joined, generation.excluded, generation.pruned, int(#generation.itemsets), frequent))
    return frequent

AprioriResult run_apriori(apriori.Counter counter, string[] universe, int minimum, int max_size, map<string, string> taxonomy, exclude_categories := false)
    result := AprioriResult()
    generation := apriori.Candidates()
    for item := universe.sorted()[]
        generation.itemsets = generation.itemsets.append([item])
    generation.joined = int(#universe)
    frequent := add_level(&result, counter, 1, generation, minimum)
    size := 2
    while size <= max_size and #frequent > 0
        generation = apriori.generate_candidates(frequent, size, taxonomy, exclude_categories)
        frequent = add_level(&result, counter, size, generation, minimum)
        size += 1
    return result

int support_in(AprioriResult result, int total, string[] items)
    return if #items == 0 then total else baskets.count_value(result.supports, items.join("+"))

int subset_count(string[] items)
    result := 1
    for: index < #items
        result *= 2
    return result

string[][] split_items(string[] items, int mask)
    string[] chosen := []
    string[] rest := []
    divisor := 1
    for item := items[]
        if (mask / divisor) % 2 == 1
            chosen = chosen.append(item)
        else
            rest = rest.append(item)
        divisor *= 2
    return [chosen, rest]

rules.RuleSet make_rules(AprioriResult frequent, int total, Params params, string[] categories := [])
    generated := 0
    rules.Rule[] kept := []
    for entry := frequent.entries[]
        if #entry.items < 2
            continue
        if #categories > 0
            allowed := false
            for item := entry.items[]
                allowed = allowed or baskets.has_item(categories, item)
            if not allowed
                continue
        for: 1 <= mask < subset_count(entry.items) - 1
            parts := split_items(entry.items, mask)
            antecedent := parts[0]
            consequent := parts[1]
            generated += 1
            rule := rules.Rule(entry.items, antecedent, consequent, entry.count, total, support_in(frequent, total, antecedent), support_in(frequent, total, consequent))
            if not rules.meets_thresholds(rule.confidence, rule.lift, params.min_confidence, params.min_lift)
                continue
            reference := rules.Ratio(0)
            for: smaller < subset_count(antecedent) - 1
                division := split_items(antecedent, smaller)
                string[] joined := division[0].concat(consequent).sorted()
                confidence := rules.Ratio(support_in(frequent, total, joined), support_in(frequent, total, division[0]))
                if confidence.compare(reference) > 0
                    reference = confidence
            rule.improvement = rule.confidence.subtract(reference)
            kept = kept.append(rule)
    kept = rules.sorted_rules(kept)
    for: index < #kept
        kept[index].rank = int(index) + 1
    return rules.RuleSet(generated, kept)

string[] recommend(string[] held, string[] candidates, int limit)
    string[] result := []
    for item := candidates[]
        if int(#result) == limit
            break
        if not baskets.has_item(held, item) and not baskets.has_item(result, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

string[] rule_candidates(rules.Rule[] entries, string[] held)
    string[] result := []
    for rule := entries[]
        if #rule.consequent == 1 and baskets.contains(held, rule.antecedent)
            result = result.append(rule.consequent[0])
    return result

class Customer(string id, baskets.Transaction[] transactions, local map<string, baskets.Product> products, local int last_day)
    history := map<string, int[]>()
    local int[] dates := []
    units := 0
    revenue := 0
    local map<string, int> category_units
    for transaction := transactions[]
        dates = dates.append(transaction.day)
        for item := transaction.products()[]
            count := baskets.count_value(transaction.counts, item)
            baskets.Product product := baskets.product_value(products, item)
            units += count
            revenue += count * product.price
            .category_units.set(product.category, baskets.count_value(category_units, product.category) + count)
            found := baskets.number_values(history, item)
            .history.set(item, found.append(transaction.day))
    for item := history.keys()[]
        .history.set(item, unique_numbers(baskets.number_values(history, item)))
    dates = unique_numbers(dates)
    days := int(#dates)
    int first := dates[0]
    int last := dates[-1]
    string[] purchased := history.keys().sorted()
    average := revenue / int(#transactions)
    string favorite := ranked_names(category_units.keys(), category_units)[0]
    string segment := if first > last_day - 28 then "NEW" elif #transactions >= 4 and last_day - last <= 14 then "LOYAL" elif last_day - last > 28 then "AT_RISK" else "REGULAR"
    string[] offer := []

int shortest_gap(int[] first_days, int[] second_days)
    best := 113
    index := -1
    for later := second_days[]
        while index + 1 < int(#first_days) and first_days[index + 1] < later
            index += 1
        if index >= 0 and later - first_days[index] < best
            best = later - first_days[index]
    return best

class Sequence(string first, string second, int customers, int base, rules.Ratio confidence, rules.Ratio lift, rules.Ratio gap)

bool sequence_before(Sequence first, Sequence second)
    if first.customers != second.customers
        return first.customers > second.customers
    order := first.confidence.compare(second.confidence)
    if order != 0
        return order > 0
    if first.first != second.first
        return collections.lex_compare(first.first.codepoints(), second.first.codepoints()) < 0
    return collections.lex_compare(first.second.codepoints(), second.second.codepoints()) < 0

class Repeat(string product, int customers, int count, int minimum, int maximum, rules.Ratio mean, rules.Ratio middle)

class RuleCheck(rules.Rule rule, int together, int base, string verdict, rules.Ratio confidence, rules.Ratio lift)

class Tally()
    cases := 0
    covered := 0
    top_hits := 0
    hits := 0
    baseline_hits := 0

    string describe()
        return "cases {cases} covered {covered} hit1 {top_hits} hit {hits} rate {report.fraction_text(rules.Ratio(hits, cases))} baseline {baseline_hits} rate {report.fraction_text(rules.Ratio(baseline_hits, cases))}"

void add_tally(Tally &tally, string item, string[] suggestion, string[] baseline)
    tally.cases += 1
    if #suggestion > 0
        tally.covered += 1
        if suggestion[0] == item
            tally.top_hits += 1
    if baskets.has_item(suggestion, item)
        tally.hits += 1
    if baskets.has_item(baseline, item)
        tally.baseline_hits += 1

class CategorySummary(string name, int products, int units, int revenue, int basket_count)

class Group(string[] members, int edges, string core, int revenue)

class Substitute(string first, string second, int together, rules.Ratio expected, rules.Ratio lift)

bool substitute_before(Substitute first, Substitute second)
    order := first.lift.compare(second.lift)
    if order != 0
        return order < 0
    order = first.expected.compare(second.expected)
    if order != 0
        return order > 0
    if first.first != second.first
        return collections.lex_compare(first.first.codepoints(), second.first.codepoints()) < 0
    return collections.lex_compare(first.second.codepoints(), second.second.codepoints()) < 0

class Trend(string name, int[] series, local rules.Ratio threshold)
    units := sum_values(series)
    local weeks := int(#series)
    local week_sum := 0
    local square_sum := 0
    local weighted_sum := 0
    for: 1 <= week <= weeks
        week_sum += week
        square_sum += week * week
        weighted_sum += week * series[week - 1]
    slope := rules.Ratio(weeks * weighted_sum - week_sum * units, weeks * square_sum - week_sum * week_sum)
    relative := rules.Ratio(0)
    verdict := "NONE"
    if units > 0
        relative = slope.scaled(weeks, units)
        verdict = if relative.compare(threshold) >= 0 then "RISING" elif relative.compare(threshold.scaled(-1)) <= 0 then "FALLING" else "FLAT"

string pad_left(string text, int width)
    result := text
    while int(#result) < width
        result = " " + result
    return result

string table_row(string label, int[] values)
    result := label
    while #result < 17
        result += " "
    for value := values[]
        result += "{value:6.}"
    return result

class MarketAnalysis(Params params, Dataset data)
    map<string, baskets.Product> products := data.products
    string[] product_names := products.keys().sorted()
    taxonomy := map<string, string>()
    string[] categories := []
    for name := product_names[]
        baskets.Product product := baskets.product_value(products, name)
        .taxonomy.set(name, product.category)
        categories = categories.append(product.category)
    categories = baskets.unique_sorted(categories)
    baskets.Transaction[] basket_list := []
    string[][] item_sets := []
    string[] customer_ids := []
    first_day := 113
    last_day := 0
    for transaction := data.transactions[]
        if transaction.counts.size() > 0
            basket_list = basket_list.append(transaction)
            item_sets = item_sets.append(transaction.products())
            customer_ids = customer_ids.append(transaction.customer)
            if transaction.day < first_day
                first_day = transaction.day
            if transaction.day > last_day
                last_day = transaction.day
    customer_ids = baskets.unique_sorted(customer_ids)
    total := int(#basket_list)
    Customer[] customers := []
    for id := customer_ids[]
        baskets.Transaction[] chosen := []
        for transaction := basket_list[]
            if transaction.customer == id
                chosen = chosen.append(transaction)
        customers = customers.append(Customer(id, chosen, products, last_day))
    counter := apriori.Counter(item_sets)
    frequent_run := AprioriResult()
    growth := fpgrowth.GrowthResult(0, 0)
    string[] closed := []
    string[] maximal := []
    string[] generators := []
    main_rules := rules.RuleSet(0, [])
    string[][] extended_sets := []
    category_counter := apriori.Counter([])
    category_run := AprioriResult()
    category_rules := rules.RuleSet(0, [])
    buyers := map<string, int>()
    sequence_pairs := 0
    Sequence[] sequences := []
    Repeat[] repeats := []
    train_run := AprioriResult()
    rules.Rule[] train_rules := []
    train_total := 0
    test_total := 0
    RuleCheck[] checks := []
    rules.Rule[] emerging := []
    tallies := array(61, fill = Tally())
    overall := Tally()
    held_out := map<string, int>()
    held_hits := map<string, int>()
    units := map<string, int>()
    revenue := map<string, int>()
    total_revenue := 0
    CategorySummary[] category_summaries := []
    Group[] groups := []
    Substitute[] substitutes := []
    week_count := (last_day - 1) / 7 + 1
    week_baskets := array(nat(week_count), fill = 0)
    week_units := array(nat(week_count), fill = 0)
    week_customers := array(nat(week_count), fill = 0)
    weekly_series := map<string, int[]>()
    Trend[] trends := []

    void .analyze_frequent()
        frequent_run = run_apriori(counter, product_names, params.min_support, params.max_size, taxonomy)
        fpgrowth.Pattern[] patterns := []
        for items := item_sets[]
            patterns = patterns.append(fpgrowth.Pattern(items, 1))
        growth = fpgrowth.fp_growth(patterns, params.min_support, params.max_size)
        map<string, int> not_closed
        map<string, int> not_maximal
        for entry := frequent_run.entries[]
            generator := true
            for subset := apriori.one_smaller_subsets(entry.items)[]
                count := support_in(frequent_run, total, subset)
                if count <= entry.count
                    generator = false
                if #subset > 0
                    key := subset.join("+")
                    .not_maximal.set(key, 1)
                    if count == entry.count
                        .not_closed.set(key, 1)
            if generator
                generators = generators.append(entry.items.join("+"))
        for entry := frequent_run.entries[]
            string key := entry.items.join("+")
            if not not_closed.has(key)
                closed = closed.append(key)
            if not not_maximal.has(key)
                maximal = maximal.append(key)
        main_rules = make_rules(frequent_run, total, params)
        for items := item_sets[]
            extended_sets = extended_sets.append(baskets.extended_basket(items, taxonomy))
        category_counter = apriori.Counter(extended_sets)
        category_run = run_apriori(category_counter, product_names.concat(categories), params.category_min_support, params.max_size, taxonomy, true)
        category_rules = make_rules(category_run, total, params, categories)

    void .analyze_sequences()
        map<string, int[]> gaps
        map<string, int[]> intervals
        map<string, int> repeaters
        for customer := customers[]
            for first := customer.purchased[]
                .buyers.set(first, baskets.count_value(buyers, first) + 1)
                first_days := baskets.number_values(customer.history, first)
                if #first_days >= 2
                    .repeaters.set(first, baskets.count_value(repeaters, first) + 1)
                    found := baskets.number_values(intervals, first)
                    for: 1 <= index < int(#first_days)
                        found = found.append(first_days[index] - first_days[index - 1])
                    .intervals.set(first, found)
                for second := customer.purchased[]
                    second_days := baskets.number_values(customer.history, second)
                    if first_days[0] < second_days[-1]
                        key := first + "+" + second
                        found := baskets.number_values(gaps, key)
                        .gaps.set(key, found.append(shortest_gap(first_days, second_days)))
        sequence_pairs = int(gaps.size())
        for key := gaps.keys().sorted()[]
            found := baskets.number_values(gaps, key)
            count := int(#found)
            if count >= params.sequence_min_support
                names := key.split("+")
                base := baskets.count_value(buyers, names[0])
                sequences = sequences.append(Sequence(names[0], names[1], count, base, rules.Ratio(count, base), rules.lift_of(int(#customers), count, base, baskets.count_value(buyers, names[1])), median(found)))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#sequences)
            entry := sequences[index]
            position := index
            while position > 0 and sequence_before(entry, sequences[position - 1])
                sequences[position] = sequences[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            sequences[position] = entry
        for item := intervals.keys().sorted()[]
            found := baskets.number_values(intervals, item).sorted()
            repeats = repeats.append(Repeat(item, baskets.count_value(repeaters, item), int(#found), found[0], found[-1], rules.Ratio(sum_values(found), int(#found)), median(found)))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#repeats)
            entry := repeats[index]
            position := index
            while position > 0
                previous := repeats[position - 1]
                order := entry.mean.compare(previous.mean)
                if order > 0 or (order == 0 and collections.lex_compare(entry.product.codepoints(), previous.product.codepoints()) >= 0)
                    break
                repeats[position] = previous
                position -= 1
            repeats[position] = entry

    void .analyze_validation()
        string[][] training := []
        string[][] testing := []
        for transaction := basket_list[]
            if transaction.day <= params.split_day
                training = training.append(transaction.products())
            else
                testing = testing.append(transaction.products())
        train_total = int(#training)
        test_total = int(#testing)
        training_counter := apriori.Counter(training)
        testing_counter := apriori.Counter(testing)
        train_run = run_apriori(training_counter, product_names, params.train_min_support, params.max_size, taxonomy)
        trained := make_rules(train_run, train_total, params)
        train_rules = trained.entries
        map<string, int> known
        for rule := train_rules[]
            key := rule.antecedent.join("+") + "->" + rule.consequent.join("+")
            .known.set(key, 1)
            first := testing_counter.support(rule.antecedent)
            second := testing_counter.support(rule.consequent)
            together := testing_counter.support(rule.itemset)
            verdict := "UNSEEN"
            confidence := rules.Ratio(0)
            lift := rules.Ratio(0)
            if first > 0 and second > 0
                confidence = rules.Ratio(together, first)
                lift = rules.lift_of(test_total, together, first, second)
                verdict = if rules.meets_thresholds(confidence, lift, params.min_confidence, params.min_lift) then "HOLD" else "FAIL"
            checks = checks.append(RuleCheck(rule, together, first, verdict, confidence, lift))
        tested := run_apriori(testing_counter, product_names, params.test_min_support, params.max_size, taxonomy)
        testing_rules := make_rules(tested, test_total, params)
        for rule := testing_rules.entries[]
            string key := rule.antecedent.join("+") + "->" + rule.consequent.join("+")
            if not known.has(key)
                emerging = emerging.append(rule)
        popularity := ranked_names(product_names, train_run.single_counts)
        for items := testing[]
            if #items < 2
                continue
            for: index < #items
                item := items[index]
                string[] held := items[0:<index].concat(items[index + 1:<#items])
                suggestion := recommend(held, rule_candidates(train_rules, held), params.recommend_top)
                baseline := recommend(held, popularity, params.recommend_top)
                add_tally(&tallies[#items], item, suggestion, baseline)
                add_tally(&overall, item, suggestion, baseline)
                .held_out.set(item, baskets.count_value(held_out, item) + 1)
                if baskets.has_item(suggestion, item)
                    .held_hits.set(item, baskets.count_value(held_hits, item) + 1)

    rules.Ratio pair_lift(apriori.Itemset pair)
        return rules.lift_of(total, pair.count, baskets.count_value(frequent_run.single_counts, pair.items[0]), baskets.count_value(frequent_run.single_counts, pair.items[1]))

    void .analyze_products()
        for transaction := basket_list[]
            for item := transaction.products()[]
                .units.set(item, baskets.count_value(units, item) + baskets.count_value(transaction.counts, item))
        for item := product_names[]
            baskets.Product product := baskets.product_value(products, item)
            amount := baskets.count_value(units, item) * product.price
            .revenue.set(item, amount)
            total_revenue += amount
        for category := categories[]
            members := 0
            quantity := 0
            amount := 0
            for item := product_names[]
                baskets.Product product := baskets.product_value(products, item)
                if product.category == category
                    members += 1
                    quantity += baskets.count_value(units, item)
                    amount += baskets.count_value(revenue, item)
            category_summaries = category_summaries.append(CategorySummary(category, members, quantity, amount, baskets.count_value(category_run.single_counts, category)))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#category_summaries)
            entry := category_summaries[index]
            position := index
            while position > 0 and category_summaries[position - 1].revenue < entry.revenue
                category_summaries[position] = category_summaries[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            category_summaries[position] = entry

    void .analyze_groups()
        string[][] edges := []
        map<string, int> degrees
        for entry := frequent_run.entries[]
            if #entry.items == 2 and pair_lift(entry).compare(params.group_min_lift) >= 0
                edges = edges.append(entry.items)
                for item := entry.items[]
                    .degrees.set(item, baskets.count_value(degrees, item) + 1)
        map<string, int> visited
        for item := product_names[]
            if visited.has(item) or baskets.count_value(degrees, item) == 0
                continue
            string[] members := []
            stack := [item]
            .visited.set(item, 1)
            while #stack != 0
                current := stack[-1]
                stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
                members = members.append(current)
                for edge := edges[]
                    if baskets.has_item(edge, current)
                        neighbor := if edge[0] == current then edge[1] else edge[0]
                        if not visited.has(neighbor)
                            .visited.set(neighbor, 1)
                            stack = stack.append(neighbor)
            members = members.sorted()
            edge_count := 0
            for edge := edges[]
                if baskets.has_item(members, edge[0])
                    edge_count += 1
            core := members[0]
            amount := 0
            for member := members[]
                amount += baskets.count_value(revenue, member)
                degree := baskets.count_value(degrees, member)
                core_degree := baskets.count_value(degrees, core)
                count := baskets.count_value(frequent_run.single_counts, member)
                core_count := baskets.count_value(frequent_run.single_counts, core)
                if degree > core_degree or (degree == core_degree and count > core_count)
                    core = member
            groups = groups.append(Group(members, edge_count, core, amount))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#groups)
            entry := groups[index]
            position := index
            while position > 0
                previous := groups[position - 1]
                if #previous.members > #entry.members or (#previous.members == #entry.members and collections.lex_compare(previous.members[0].codepoints(), entry.members[0].codepoints()) <= 0)
                    break
                groups[position] = previous
                position -= 1
            groups[position] = entry

    void .analyze_substitutes()
        string[][] singles := frequent_run.levels[0].itemsets
        for: first < #singles
            left := singles[first][0]
            for: first + 1 <= second < #singles
                right := singles[second][0]
                first_count := baskets.count_value(frequent_run.single_counts, left)
                second_count := baskets.count_value(frequent_run.single_counts, right)
                if first_count * second_count >= params.negative_min_expected * total
                    int together := counter.support([left, right])
                    lift := rules.lift_of(total, together, first_count, second_count)
                    if lift.compare(params.negative_max_lift) <= 0
                        substitutes = substitutes.append(Substitute(left, right, together, rules.Ratio(first_count * second_count, total), lift))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#substitutes)
            entry := substitutes[index]
            position := index
            while position > 0 and substitute_before(entry, substitutes[position - 1])
                substitutes[position] = substitutes[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            substitutes[position] = entry

    void .analyze_trends()
        string[][] weekly_customers := []
        for: week < week_count
            weekly_customers = weekly_customers.append([])
        for name := categories.concat(product_names)[]
            series := array(nat(week_count), fill = 0)
            .weekly_series.set(name, series)
        for transaction := basket_list[]
            week := (transaction.day - 1) / 7
            week_baskets[week] += 1
            week_units[week] += transaction.units()
            weekly_customers[week] = weekly_customers[week].append(transaction.customer)
            for item := transaction.products()[]
                baskets.Product product := baskets.product_value(products, item)
                count := baskets.count_value(transaction.counts, item)
                series := baskets.number_values(weekly_series, item)
                series[week] += count
                .weekly_series.set(item, series)
                category_series := baskets.number_values(weekly_series, product.category)
                category_series[week] += count
                .weekly_series.set(product.category, category_series)
        for: week < week_count
            week_customers[week] = int(#baskets.unique_sorted(weekly_customers[week]))
        for name := categories.concat(product_names)[]
            trends = trends.append(Trend(name, baskets.number_values(weekly_series, name), params.trend_threshold))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#trends)
            entry := trends[index]
            position := index
            while position > 0
                previous := trends[position - 1]
                earlier := false
                if entry.units > 0 and previous.units == 0
                    earlier = true
                elif entry.units > 0 and previous.units > 0
                    int order := entry.relative.compare(previous.relative)
                    earlier = order > 0 or (order == 0 and collections.lex_compare(entry.name.codepoints(), previous.name.codepoints()) < 0)
                elif entry.units == 0 and previous.units == 0
                    earlier = collections.lex_compare(entry.name.codepoints(), previous.name.codepoints()) < 0
                if not earlier
                    break
                trends[position] = previous
                position -= 1
            trends[position] = entry

    void .run()
        .analyze_frequent()
        .analyze_sequences()
        .analyze_validation()
        .analyze_products()
        .analyze_groups()
        .analyze_substitutes()
        .analyze_trends()
        for: index < #customers
            held := customers[index].purchased
            customers[index].offer = recommend(held, rule_candidates(main_rules.entries, held), params.recommend_top)

    string[] growth_lines()
        map<string, int> found
        for entry := growth.itemsets[]
            .found.set(entry.items.join("+"), entry.count)
        string[] missing := []
        string[] extra := []
        for entry := frequent_run.entries[]
            string key := entry.items.join("+")
            if not found.has(key) or baskets.count_value(found, key) != entry.count
                missing = missing.append("ONLY_APRIORI {key} {entry.count}")
        for: 1 <= size <= params.max_size
            for key := found.keys().sorted()[]
                items := key.split("+")
                if int(#items) == size
                    count := baskets.count_value(found, key)
                    if not frequent_run.supports.has(key) or baskets.count_value(frequent_run.supports, key) != count
                        extra = extra.append("ONLY_FPGROWTH {key} {count}")
        status := if #missing == 0 and #extra == 0 then "MATCH" else "MISMATCH"
        lines := ["FPGROWTH header {growth.header_count} nodes {growth.node_count} conditional_trees {growth.conditional_trees} conditional_nodes {growth.conditional_nodes} itemsets {#growth.itemsets} {status}"]
        return lines.concat(missing).concat(extra)

    string[] summary_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for problem := data.errors[]
            lines = lines.append("ERROR {problem}")
        largest := 0
        size_total := 0
        for items := item_sets[]
            count := int(#items)
            size_total += count
            if count > largest
                largest = count
        multi_day := 0
        for customer := customers[]
            if customer.days >= 2
                multi_day += 1
        lines = lines.append("ITEMS rows {data.item_rows} adopted {products.size()} categories {#categories}")
        lines = lines.append("TRANSACTIONS lines {data.transaction_lines} adopted {data.adopted} rejected {data.rejected} duplicates {data.duplicates} transactions {#data.transactions} empty {int(#data.transactions) - total}")
        lines = lines.append("BASKETS count {total} customers {#customers} first_day {first_day} last_day {last_day} average_size {report.fraction_text(rules.Ratio(size_total, total))} largest {largest}")
        for: 1 <= size <= largest
            count := 0
            for items := item_sets[]
                if int(#items) == size
                    count += 1
            lines = lines.append("SIZE {size} baskets {count} share {report.percent_text(count, total)}")
        lines = lines.append("FREQUENT itemsets {#frequent_run.entries} closed {#closed} maximal {#maximal} generators {#generators} levels {#frequent_run.levels}")
        lines = lines.concat(growth_lines())
        lines = lines.append("RULES generated {main_rules.generated} passed {#main_rules.entries} productive {main_rules.productive}")
        for level := category_run.levels[]
            lines = lines.append("CATEGORY_LEVEL {level.number} candidates {level.candidates} taxonomy {level.excluded} pruned {level.pruned} counted {level.counted} frequent {#level.itemsets}")
        lines = lines.append("CATEGORY_RULES itemsets {#category_run.entries} generated {category_rules.generated} passed {#category_rules.entries} productive {category_rules.productive}")
        lines = lines.append("SEQUENCES customers {#customers} multi_day {multi_day} pairs {sequence_pairs} frequent {#sequences}")
        return lines

    string[] itemset_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for level := frequent_run.levels[]
            lines = lines.append("LEVEL {level.number} candidates {level.candidates} pruned {level.pruned} counted {level.counted} frequent {#level.itemsets}")
            for items := level.itemsets[]
                string key := items.join("+")
                lines = lines.append("{key} {baskets.count_value(frequent_run.supports, key)}")
        return lines

    string[] closed_maximal_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        labels := ["CLOSED", "MAXIMAL", "GENERATOR"]
        sections := [closed, maximal, generators]
        for: index < #labels
            for key := sections[index][]
                lines = lines.append("{labels[index]} {key} {baskets.count_value(frequent_run.supports, key)}")
        return lines

    string[] sequence_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for: index < #sequences
            entry := sequences[index]
            lines = lines.append("SEQ {index + 1} {entry.first} -> {entry.second} customers {entry.customers} base {entry.base} confidence {report.fraction_text(entry.confidence)} lift {report.fraction_text(entry.lift)} gap {report.fraction_text(entry.gap)}")
        for entry := repeats[]
            lines = lines.append("REPEAT {entry.product} customers {entry.customers} intervals {entry.count} min {entry.minimum} max {entry.maximum} mean {report.fraction_text(entry.mean)} median {report.fraction_text(entry.middle)}")
        return lines

    string[] validation_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        hold := 0
        fail := 0
        unseen := 0
        for check := checks[]
            rule := check.rule
            measured := "confidence - lift -"
            if check.verdict == "UNSEEN"
                unseen += 1
            else
                measured = "confidence {report.fraction_text(check.confidence)} lift {report.fraction_text(check.lift)}"
                if check.verdict == "HOLD"
                    hold += 1
                else
                    fail += 1
            lines = lines.append("RULE {rule.rank} {report.rule_arrow(rule)} train {rule.count} confidence {report.fraction_text(rule.confidence)} lift {report.fraction_text(rule.lift)} test {check.together} of {check.base} {measured} {check.verdict}")
        for rule := emerging[]
            lines = lines.append("EMERGING {rule.rank} {report.rule_arrow(rule)} test {rule.count} confidence {report.fraction_text(rule.confidence)} lift {report.fraction_text(rule.lift)}")
        lines = lines.append("VALIDATION train {train_total} test {test_total} itemsets {#train_run.entries} rules {#train_rules} hold {hold} fail {fail} unseen {unseen} emerging {#emerging}")
        for: size < #tallies
            if tallies[size].cases > 0
                lines = lines.append("RECOMMEND size {size} {tallies[size].describe()}")
        lines = lines.append("RECOMMEND total {overall.describe()}")
        return lines

    string partner_text(string name)
        best := ""
        best_lift := rules.Ratio(0)
        best_count := 0
        for entry := frequent_run.entries[]
            if #entry.items == 2 and baskets.has_item(entry.items, name)
                string other := if entry.items[0] == name then entry.items[1] else entry.items[0]
                rules.Ratio lift := pair_lift(entry)
                order := lift.compare(best_lift)
                if best == "" or order > 0 or (order == 0 and (entry.count > best_count or (entry.count == best_count and collections.lex_compare(other.codepoints(), best.codepoints()) < 0)))
                    best = other
                    best_lift = lift
                    best_count = entry.count
        return if best == "" then "none" else best + " " + report.fraction_text(best_lift)

    string strongest_text(string name)
        for rule := main_rules.entries[]
            if baskets.has_item(rule.itemset, name)
                return "{rule.rank} {report.rule_arrow(rule)}"
        return "none"

    string[] matrix_lines(string label, string[] names, map<string, int> counts, apriori.Counter source)
        string[] lines := []
        heading := "    "
        for: index < #names
            name := names[index]
            lines = lines.append("{label} {index + 1} {name} baskets {baskets.count_value(counts, name)}")
            heading += pad_left(string(index + 1), 7)
        lines = lines.append(heading)
        for: row < #names
            line := pad_left(string(row + 1), 4)
            for: column < #names
                cell := "-"
                if row != column
                    numerator := 100 * source.total * source.support([names[row], names[column]])
                    denominator := baskets.count_value(counts, names[row]) * baskets.count_value(counts, names[column])
                    cell = string(numerator / denominator)
                line += pad_left(cell, 7)
            lines = lines.append(line)
        return lines

        string[] lines := []
        ranked := ranked_names(product_names, revenue)
        for: index < #ranked

            baskets.Product product := baskets.product_value(products, name)

                    containing += 1
            lines = lines.append("ITEM {index + 1} {name} {product.category} price {report.money_text(product.price)} units {baskets.count_value(units, name)} revenue {report.money_text(amount)} share {report.percent_text(amount, total_revenue)} baskets {count} support {report.fraction_text(rules.Ratio(count, total))} customers {baskets.count_value(buyers, name)} itemsets {containing} heldout {baskets.count_value(held_out, name)} hits {baskets.count_value(held_hits, name)} partner {partner_text(name)} best {strongest_text(name)}")
        for entry := category_summaries[]
            lines = lines.append("CATEGORY {entry.name} items {entry.products} units {entry.units} revenue {report.money_text(entry.revenue)} share {report.percent_text(entry.revenue, total_revenue)} baskets {entry.basket_count} support {report.fraction_text(rules.Ratio(entry.basket_count, total))}")
        quantity := 0
        for name := product_names[]
            quantity += baskets.count_value(units, name)
        lines = lines.append("TOTAL items {#product_names} units {quantity} revenue {report.money_text(total_revenue)} baskets {total} customers {#customers}")
        for: index < #groups
            entry := groups[index]
            lines = lines.append("GROUP {index + 1} items {#entry.members} edges {entry.edges} core {entry.core} revenue {report.money_text(entry.revenue)} share {report.percent_text(entry.revenue, total_revenue)} members {report.itemset_text(entry.members)}")
        for entry := substitutes[]
            lines = lines.append("SUBSTITUTE {entry.first} {entry.second} count {entry.together} expected {report.fraction_text(entry.expected)} lift {report.fraction_text(entry.lift)}")
        top := ranked_names(product_names, frequent_run.single_counts)
        lines = lines.concat(matrix_lines("MATRIX", top[0:<params.matrix_size], frequent_run.single_counts, counter))
        category_order := ranked_names(categories, category_run.single_counts)
        return lines.concat(matrix_lines("CATEGORY_MATRIX", category_order, category_run.single_counts, category_counter))

    string[] trend_lines()
        int[] weeks := []
        for: 1 <= week <= week_count
            weeks = weeks.append(week)
        lines := [table_row("WEEK", weeks), table_row("BASKETS", week_baskets), table_row("UNITS", week_units), table_row("CUSTOMERS", week_customers)]

import rules = "./rules.qui"

string fraction_text(rules.Ratio value)
    numerator := if value.numerator < 0 then -value.numerator else value.numerator
    scaled := 10000 * numerator / value.denominator
    whole := scaled / 10000
    fraction := scaled % 10000
    decimal := "{whole}.{fraction:04.}"
    if value.numerator < 0
        sign := if scaled > 0 then "-" else ""
        return "-{numerator}/{value.denominator}={sign}{decimal}"
    return "{numerator}/{value.denominator}={decimal}"

string percent_text(int part, int whole)
    scaled := 10000 * part / whole
    fraction := scaled % 100
    return "{scaled / 100}.{fraction:02.}%"

string money_text(int cents)
    fraction := cents % 100
    return "{cents / 100}.{fraction:02.}"

string itemset_text(string[] items)
    return items.join("+")

string rule_arrow(rules.Rule rule)
    return itemset_text(rule.antecedent) + " -> " + itemset_text(rule.consequent)

string rule_csv_line(rules.Rule rule)
    conviction := if rule.infinite then "INF" else fraction_text(rule.conviction)
    fields := [string(rule.rank), itemset_text(rule.antecedent), itemset_text(rule.consequent), string(rule.count), fraction_text(rule.support), fraction_text(rule.confidence), fraction_text(rule.lift), fraction_text(rule.leverage), conviction, fraction_text(rule.improvement)]
    return fields.join(",")

string[] rules_csv(rules.Rule[] entries)
    lines := ["rank,antecedent,consequent,count,support,confidence,lift,leverage,conviction,improvement"]
    for rule := entries[]
        lines = lines.append(rule_csv_line(rule))

import collections
int gcd(int first, int second)
    left := if first < 0 then -first else first
    right := if second < 0 then -second else second
    while right > 0
        remainder := left % right
        left = right
        right = remainder
    return left

class Ratio(int numerator, denominator := 1)
    if denominator < 0
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator
    local divisor := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    numerator /= divisor
    denominator /= divisor

    int compare(Ratio other)
        left := numerator * other.denominator
        right := other.numerator * denominator
        return if left < right then -1 elif left > right then 1 else 0

    Ratio subtract(Ratio other)
        return Ratio(numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Ratio scaled(int factor, divisor := 1)
        return Ratio(numerator * factor, denominator * divisor)

Ratio lift_of(int total, int together, int first_count, int second_count)
    return Ratio(total * together, first_count * second_count)

class Rule(string[] itemset, string[] antecedent, string[] consequent, int count, local int total, local int antecedent_count, local int consequent_count)
    support := Ratio(count, total)
    confidence := Ratio(count, antecedent_count)
    lift := lift_of(total, count, antecedent_count, consequent_count)
    leverage := Ratio(total * count - antecedent_count * consequent_count, total * total)
    infinite := antecedent_count == count
    conviction := Ratio(0)
    if not infinite
        conviction = Ratio((total - consequent_count) * antecedent_count, total * (antecedent_count - count))
    improvement := Ratio(0)
    rank := 0

bool meets_thresholds(Ratio confidence, Ratio lift, Ratio min_confidence, Ratio min_lift)
    return confidence.compare(min_confidence) >= 0 and lift.compare(min_lift) >= 0

bool before(Rule first, Rule second)
    int order := first.confidence.compare(second.confidence)
    if order != 0
        return order > 0
    order = first.lift.compare(second.lift)
    if order != 0
        return order > 0
    if first.count != second.count
        return first.count > second.count
    left := first.antecedent.join("+")
    right := second.antecedent.join("+")
    if left != right
        return collections.lex_compare(left.codepoints(), right.codepoints()) < 0
    return collections.lex_compare(first.consequent.join("+").codepoints(), second.consequent.join("+").codepoints()) < 0

Rule[] sorted_rules(Rule[] values)
    if #values < 2
        return values
    middle := #values / 2
    left := sorted_rules(values[0:<middle])
    right := sorted_rules(values[middle:<#values])
    Rule[] result := []
    nat first := 0
    nat second := 0
    while first < #left and second < #right
        if before(right[second], left[first])
            result = result.append(right[second])
            second += 1
        else
            result = result.append(left[first])
            first += 1
    return result.concat(left[first:<#left]).concat(right[second:<#right])

class RuleSet(int generated, Rule[] entries)
    productive := 0
    for entry := entries[]
        if entry.improvement.numerator > 0
            productive += 1
